-- Assign first sub-category of each main category as fallback for unassigned items
-- Power Tools → Drills & Hammer Drills (id:16) -- but compressors in power-tools go to portable-compressors (id:60)
-- First handle compressors in power-tools category
UPDATE equipment_items ei
JOIN equipment_categories ec ON ei.categoryId = ec.id
SET ei.subCategoryId = 60
WHERE ei.subCategoryId IS NULL
  AND ec.slug = 'power-tools'
  AND (LOWER(ei.name) LIKE '%compressor%' OR LOWER(ei.name) LIKE '%air fox%' OR LOWER(ei.name) LIKE '%bauer%');

-- Fans in power-tools → general (use drills as fallback)
UPDATE equipment_items ei
JOIN equipment_categories ec ON ei.categoryId = ec.id
SET ei.subCategoryId = 16
WHERE ei.subCategoryId IS NULL
  AND ec.slug = 'power-tools'
  AND LOWER(ei.name) LIKE '%fan%';

-- Tool chests/storage in power-tools → clamping-holding (id:58)
UPDATE equipment_items ei
JOIN equipment_categories ec ON ei.categoryId = ec.id
SET ei.subCategoryId = 58
WHERE ei.subCategoryId IS NULL
  AND ec.slug = 'power-tools'
  AND (LOWER(ei.name) LIKE '%chest%' OR LOWER(ei.name) LIKE '%drawer%' OR LOWER(ei.name) LIKE '%tool box%' OR LOWER(ei.name) LIKE '%toolbox%');

-- Vacuums in power-tools → grinders-sanders (id:2) as closest match
UPDATE equipment_items ei
JOIN equipment_categories ec ON ei.categoryId = ec.id
SET ei.subCategoryId = 2
WHERE ei.subCategoryId IS NULL
  AND ec.slug = 'power-tools'
  AND LOWER(ei.name) LIKE '%vacuum%';

-- Gas tanks in power-tools → welding accessories (id:35)
UPDATE equipment_items ei
JOIN equipment_categories ec ON ei.categoryId = ec.id
SET ei.subCategoryId = 35
WHERE ei.subCategoryId IS NULL
  AND ec.slug = 'power-tools'
  AND (LOWER(ei.name) LIKE '%gas%' OR LOWER(ei.name) LIKE '%argon%');

-- Remaining power-tools unassigned → drills as default
UPDATE equipment_items ei
JOIN equipment_categories ec ON ei.categoryId = ec.id
SET ei.subCategoryId = 16
WHERE ei.subCategoryId IS NULL AND ec.slug = 'power-tools';

-- Batteries & Power unassigned → battery-chargers (id:53)
UPDATE equipment_items ei
JOIN equipment_categories ec ON ei.categoryId = ec.id
SET ei.subCategoryId = 53
WHERE ei.subCategoryId IS NULL AND ec.slug = 'batteries-power';

-- Compressors & Air unassigned → portable-compressors (id:60)
UPDATE equipment_items ei
JOIN equipment_categories ec ON ei.categoryId = ec.id
SET ei.subCategoryId = 60
WHERE ei.subCategoryId IS NULL AND ec.slug = 'compressors-air';

-- Hand Tools unassigned → striking-tools (id:56)

JOIN equipment_categories ec ON ei.categoryId = ec.id
